skill.description: Lemon8 data assistant for searching content, discovering trends, reviewing posts, checking profiles, and researching topics through MaxHub APIs.
skill.summary: Search and analyze Lemon8 content, users, comments, topics, and trends through MaxHub.

security_audit.summary: Most high and medium static alerts are false positives from Markdown documentation, API key setup examples, and Lemon8 identifier parameter names. Confirmed static risk is limited to intentional MaxHub network access for API calls. A medium semantic privacy risk remains because the skill can collect Lemon8 profile, follower, following, comment, and batch ID data at scale.

remediation.suggestion: Clearly disclose that searches, identifiers, and API requests are sent to MaxHub at www.aconfig.cn.

remediation.issue: Social profile and follower data collection
remediation.suggestion: Add privacy guidance, discourage bulk profiling, and tell users to follow Lemon8 policies and applicable data protection rules.

remediation.issue: Shell curl templates with user parameters
remediation.suggestion: Tell agents and users to URL-encode parameters and avoid raw shell interpolation when building curl requests.

content.value_statement: Lemon8 research often requires searching posts, profiles, topics, and trends across several endpoints. This skill routes requests to MaxHub APIs and returns concise discovery, comparison, and analysis results.
actual_capabilities: Search Lemon8 content, users, hashtags, articles, and topics through MaxHub endpoints.
Retrieve discover page banners, tabs, hot search keywords, and editor-selected content.
Fetch post details, comment lists, topic information, user profiles, followers, and following lists.
Extract Lemon8 post IDs and user IDs from share links, including batch lookup workflows.
Compare searches or topics and summarize trends in English or Chinese.
limitations: Requires a valid MAXHUB_API_KEY and network access to www.aconfig.cn.
Results depend on MaxHub API availability, permissions, and Lemon8 source data freshness.
Batch ID lookup is limited by the documented endpoint behavior and request limits.
The skill does not verify legal rights, platform policy compliance, or consent for data use.

use_cases.title: Research Lifestyle Trends
use_cases.description: Find Lemon8 posts, hashtags, and hot searches to identify current lifestyle content patterns.

use_cases.title: Plan Brand Content
use_cases.description: Review high-interest posts and comments to understand content formats that engage Lemon8 audiences.

use_cases.title: Analyze Creator Presence
use_cases.description: Fetch profile, topic, post, follower, and following data to prepare a focused creator overview.

prompt_templates.title: Search a Topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Lemon8 for "summer skincare" and summarize the top content themes in English.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Post
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this Lemon8 share link to find the post ID, fetch the post details, and summarize the main comment sentiment.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Hashtags
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare Lemon8 results for "capsule wardrobe" and "minimalist outfit". Show key differences in topics, formats, and audience signals.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Trend Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Research Lemon8 wellness trends using search, hot keywords, topics, and editor picks. Produce a concise report with evidence and content recommendations.

output_examples.input: Search Lemon8 for healthy meal prep.
output_examples.output: A ranked summary of recurring meal prep themes, common post formats, notable hashtags, and suggested follow-up searches.

output_examples.input: Analyze this creator profile and recent topic activity.
output_examples.output: A creator overview with profile signals, related topics, audience indicators, and caveats about data freshness.

output_examples.input: Compare two Lemon8 hashtags for a brand campaign.
output_examples.output: A side-by-side comparison of content volume signals, topic fit, engagement clues, and recommended campaign angle.

best_practices: Set MAXHUB_API_KEY in a secure environment variable or approved secret store.
Start with narrow searches, then expand only when the returned data supports it.
Treat profile, follower, and comment data as sensitive research material.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into prompts, shared documents, or final reports.
Do not run broad scraping workflows without checking policy and privacy requirements.
Do not treat returned social data as complete, current, or legally cleared for reuse.

faq.question: What does this skill connect to?
faq.answer: It connects to MaxHub APIs at www.aconfig.cn to query Lemon8-related data.

faq.question: Do I need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. You need a MAXHUB_API_KEY with permission to use the documented endpoints.

faq.question: Can it search in English and Chinese?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill supports prompts and output guidance for both English and Chinese.

faq.question: Can it analyze individual users?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents profile, follower, following, and user ID workflows when the API allows access.

faq.question: Does it store my API key?
faq.answer: The skill documentation uses environment variables or tool configuration. It tells the assistant not to print key values.

faq.question: What should I verify before using results?
faq.answer: Verify data freshness, API permissions, privacy obligations, and Lemon8 policy requirements before acting on results.
